15: ואלא אטמא במוקדשין And perhaps [the Mishna is referring to] an impure person [slaughtering] sacrificial [animals] - You have said that the Mishna is speaking of [a situation where someone] is told, "Do not slaughter." Why, then, discuss [an impure person slaughtering sacrificial animals] specifically [in regards to] "and others watch him"? Haven't you already said that his [testimony] is believed if he said, "It is clear to me [that I did not touch the carcass after the slaughter]"?
